# Power armor: All power armor in comparison

![Power armor: All power armor in comparison](/uploads/50_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

All power armor in Fallout 76 has its advantages and disadvantages. Some have been there from the beginning, some have been added in updates. We have summarized all available power armor in this overview and draw a conclusion for our favorite: The best power armor (from our point of view).

## General power armor properties

All power armor has **42% damage reduction** (7% per piece) and **90% radiation reduction** (15% per piece). This provides e.g. great advantages in nuclear missile impact zones or in the tunnels of "radiation brawl". Of course, you can withstand more in power armor than in normal armor. However, the armor is loud and heavy and stealth is not possible, which means you become the target of attacks more quickly.

Furthermore, the chassis of the power armor alone grants you a **bonus of +10 strength**. This means you can carry 50 more with a power armor chassis, even without additional parts or set bonuses. [ *Carry Capacity = Base of 150 + (Strength * 5) ]*

In general, it is recommended to play with power armor if you play heavy weapons, as the "Stabilized" (intelligence) perk only works in power armor and provides enormous advantages. Power armor is not recommended with rifles, pistols or melee combat.

## Vulcan Power Armor [New RAID Power Armor]

Damage resistance: 560

Energy resistance: 600

Radiation resistance: 200

Radiation reduction: -85% (other PAs have -90%)

Level: 50

Set Bonus: +25% Fusion Core Durability & +25% AP Regeneration

Not tradable.

Unique Mods:

- Gimbal Bracers (Armmod)
 - Reduces the weapon's firing cone by 50%
 - Will not stack if both arms are modified
- Ultracite Bracers (Armmod)
 - Targets suffer 25 poison and radiation damage/s for 10s
 - Will not stack if both arms are modified
- Elastic servos (leg mod)
 - +50% jump height
 - Should be stacked when both legs are modified
Note: Marsupial has +320%/+400% with Stranger by the Dozen
- Reflection unit (hull mod)
 - Melee attackers suffer bleed damage

Available (with chance) in all levels of RAID: Radiant Depths.

See: Raid 'Gleaming Depths': Guide & Rewards (Gleaming Depths)

## Union (Union) power armor

Damage resistance: 489

Energy Resistance: 295

Radiation resistance: 265

Level: 50

Set Bonus: +150 Poison Resistance, +75 Carrying Capacity

Not tradable.

Reward on board 10 (09/13/2022 - 12/06/2022)

Available from Guiseppe in the Whitespring Sanctuary for stamps since Season 11

## Hellcat power armor

Damage resistance: 436

Energy resistance: 320

Radiation resistance: 320

Level: 50

Per part: "Reduces incoming ballistic damage by 2%" so a total of 12% (arms, legs, torso + helmet, that counts even though it doesn't say so)

Reward of the new "Steel Reign" quest line.

Drops from Legendary enemies and Legendary events and can be Legendary crafted. Not tradable.

## T-65 power armor

Damage resistance: 565

Energy Resistance: 470

Radiation resistance: 470

Level: 50

Blueprints only available for gold: from Minerva or from Vault 79 (Regs / Secret Service)

Drops from legendary
